item.title: Implement specified token bucket and keyed rate limiter
item.brief: Implement the behavior in the repository's SPEC.md in ratelimit.py, replacing the stubs. Match all specified semantics and error cases: positive capacity/refill rate, initially full token buckets, continuous fractional refill capped at capacity, atomic try_acquire failure, validation of n, non-consuming wait_time, and clock rollback handling that does not advance the latest observed time or alter tokens. Implement KeyedLimiter with independent buckets per hashable key, max_keys validation, LRU eviction on new keys, and both try_acquire and wait_time counting as use; an evicted key starts full. Keep the implementation dependency-free using only the Python standard library, preserve the given public signatures, and account for edge cases beyond the basic tests. Run the existing tests and focused checks for the specified edge cases, then commit the implementation.

pr.body: Implemented continuous capped refill with fractional tokens, input validation, no-consumption failure, wait-time calculation, and clock rollback high-water behavior in ratelimit.py. Added independent per-key buckets with max_keys validation and LRU eviction; both keyed operations refresh LRU usage, and evicted keys restart full. Added tests in test_ratelimit.py for refill, rollback, validation, wait purity, independence, and LRU. Checks: python -m unittest -v (7 passed); git diff --check (passed). Uses only the Python standard library. Review found and resolved a rollback wait_time defect; delta re-review passed.
pr.summary: Implemented full token bucket and keyed LRU rate limiting. Before: both classes were stubs; now callers can acquire, inspect availability, calculate waits, and enforce independent per-key limits.
